newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to see coffee production deficit - Abecafe.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to see coffee production deficit - Abecafe.

text.p: Brazil Coffee Exporters' Association (Abecafe) still expects to see a production deficit of around four million 60-kg bags in 1997/98 despite a higher second crop estimate of 24 million 60-kg bags.
"A crop of around 24 million bags compares with a demand, between exports and internal demand, of 28 million bags a year," Abecafe said in a statement.
"If the numbers in the second estimate are confirmed, we will have a shortfall of four million bags," it added.
Abecafe's most recent estimate compares with a forecast of 23.2 million bags in February this year. The 800,000 bag increase was entirely of arabica coffee, mainly in the state of Minas Gerais.
Given expectations of the shortfall, Abecafe is calling for a "transparent and co-ordinated" plan for the sale of government stocks throughout the 1997/98 crop year.
One way of softening any negative effects on prices would to hold auctions more frequently, Abecafe suggested.
Therefore, it recommends that auctions be held twice a month in the coming year as opposed to the currently monthly sale. ((-Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
